def: A concomitant medication administered alongside the primary treatment
Another drug used in combination with the main therapeutic agent
与主要治疗药物同时使用的伴随药物
在治疗过程中联合使用的其他药物成分
The name of the specific pharmaceutical substance or medication used
The active chemical agent or drug brand administered in the treatment
使用的特定药用物质或药物的名称
治疗中施用的活性化学制剂或药物品牌
The specific amount or quantity of the drug administered
The defined strength or volume of the medication given to the subject
施用药物的具体数量或剂量
给予受试者的药物的规定强度或体积
The total length of time over which the treatment was administered
The time period defining how long the therapeutic course continued
进行治疗的总时长
定义疗程持续多久的时间段
The clinical outcome, symptom, or adverse event resulting from the treatment
The observed medical reaction or phenomenon triggered by the intervention
由治疗产生的临床结果、症状或不良事件
由医疗干预引起的观察到的反应或医学现象
The frequency or rate at which the treatment is administered
How often the medication is taken or applied within a given period
施用治疗的频率或速率
在特定时期内服用或使用药物的频次
The method or path by which the drug is introduced into the body
The mode of administration, such as oral, intravenous, or topical
药物被引入体内的途径或方法
给药方式，例如口服、静脉注射或局部给药
The specific age of the patient or subject involved in the event
A numerical or descriptive value indicating how old the subject is
涉及事件的患者或受试者的具体年龄
指示受试者年纪的数值或描述性值
A pre-existing medical condition or co-morbidity affecting the subject
An underlying illness or disorder the patient had separate from the treatment indication
影响受试者的既往医疗状况或合并症
患者除治疗适应症外患有的潜在疾病或失调
The biological sex or gender identity of the subject
An indication of whether the patient is male or female
受试者的生物性别或性别认同
指示患者是男性还是女性的描述
A specific demographic group or population segment the subject belongs to
The wider group of people defined by shared characteristics (e.g., pediatric) to which the subject belongs
受试者所属的特定人口统计群体或人群细分
受试者所属的具有共同特征（如儿科人群）的广泛群体
The racial or ethnic background of the subject
A descriptor identifying the subject's race or ethnicity
受试者的种族或民族背景
用于标识受试者种族或族裔的描述符
The patient or individual experiencing the medical event or adverse reaction
The primary entity undergoing treatment or suffering from a clinical condition
经历医疗事件或不良反应的患者或个体
正在接受治疗或患有某种临床状况的主要实体
The medical condition or indication for which the treatment is prescribed
The target disease or symptom that the medication aims to treat
开具治疗处方所针对的医疗状况或适应症
药物旨在治疗的目标疾病或症状
The time interval between the administration of treatment and the onset of the effect
The duration elapsed from the start or end of therapy to the observation of the event
从施用治疗到效果开始显现之间的时间间隔
从疗法开始或结束到观察到事件所经过的持续时间
The specific word or phrase in the text that most clearly indicates the occurrence of a medical event.
A specific textual cue signaling the presence of an adverse drug reaction or a potential therapeutic effect.
最能明确指示医疗事件（如不良反应或治疗效果）发生的核心词或短语。
标志着药物不良反应或潜在治疗作用出现的关键提示词。
The medical intervention, procedure, or therapy administered to the subject
The comprehensive course of action taken to manage a health problem
施予受试者的医疗干预、程序或疗法
为管理健康问题而采取的综合行动方案
